Take the verifier with you.

The downloadable HTML contains the verifier and its interface. Open it in a desktop browser, disconnect from the network and import your bundle. Some mobile file preview apps do not run JavaScript.

You have the self-contained HTML edition. Keep this file and open it again whenever you need it.

Know the verification boundary.

This is the same browser demo implementation, running as a separate artifact—not a third-party audit. It supports a safe-integer profile; full Python-verifier parity is not claimed. A self-consistent bundle does not establish issuer identity, source truth or regulatory acceptance.
